description: Labelled helpdesk messages for the NLU accuracy check. Each item is one user sentence with the intent and the slots a correct labelling must contain. A slot omitted here must come back null.

labels.text: The VPN keeps failing with ERR-VPN-809. What does that code mean?
It's been doing this all week and it's blocking the month-end close. I'd like it raised as a ticket.
Can someone from the desk come to my desk and look at it?
The Pune office.
Third floor, desk 14.
Thursday, please.
Make it Thursday at 4 pm.
Yes, go ahead and book that.
No, leave Friday. Thursday alone is enough.
How long is the laptop refresh cycle now, and which model would I get?
What does SLA-P1 promise for a first response?
How long does a guest Wi-Fi pass last?
Is there a way to print to my home printer while the VPN is connected?
Hi, I'm Meera Iyer, employee E-10428. My laptop runs Windows 11.
It's a LAP-T14G3, the older 14 inch model.
I sit at the Pune office, on the third floor.
Lovely weather today, isn't it?
Hope your day is going well!
What is the status of ticket TCK-1001?
My printer shows ERR-PRINT-017 and nothing comes out. Please fix it.
yes
no
Thanks, that's all for today.
Where do I sit?
Which laptop do I use?
I have moved from Pune to Hyderabad.
